candidates.change_summary: Return the BEACON_SLOT instead of the IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT so proxiableUUID() yields a different bytes32 value.
Return the ADMIN_SLOT instead of the IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT so proxiableUUID() yields a different bytes32 value.
Return a zero bytes32 value instead of the IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT so proxiableUUID() yields a different bytes32 value.
Remove the __Access_init(_accessControl) call so the accessControl address is never set during initialization.
Remove `$._initialized = 1;` so the initialized version is never set and initialize() can be called again.
Remove the post-statement block that resets _initializing and emits Initialized(1), so the event is no longer emitted.
